name: Optimism
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 4, medium 4, mesmerist 4, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (a mirror)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You bolster the target’s confidence and instill a sense of bravery.

This confidence manifests as a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls. Additionally, the target increases the bonus to +4 on saves vs. emotion and fear effects. No amount of failure counters the spell’s effects—the target simply explains away negative events with a self-assured perspective.

Certain events can solidify the character’s belief that they are the best. Whenever the target rolls a natural 20 on an attack roll or saving throw, or succeeds on an ability or skill check by more than 5, the bonuses to rolls imposed by optimism becomes +3 (or +6 vs. emotion or fear) for 1 round.

This increased penalty doesn’t stack, even if multiple triumphs occur on the same round.
